description: Studio portrait of the Armuza (catalogue: Armoza) family in Middle Eastern costume. Catalogue caption: right to left, top: Rahel, Yitzhak and Avraham; front: Rosa and Moreno (grandfather of Moni). Yitzhak Armuza, a butcher, was a founder of Mazkeret Moshe and of the Hesed VeRahamim Synagogue. Catalogue notes (Hebrew) carry the tavern story ('some say' he put 10 liras on the table to remove the tavern and build the synagogue): Attributed tradition. Hesed VeRahamim society founded in the Old City by Sephardi families in 1925 (soup kitchen, kindergarten, 'Mazor' sick fund).
